title: T0 Orders domain logic + mail log
body:
Target: front-end/src/features/orders/ (new lib/ and hooks/ files), front-end/src/features/notifications/ (new), front-end/src/features/demo/types.ts and seed.ts (additive). No UI screens.
Change: build the shared order logic every later screen uses, so no screen writes its own. (1) Selectors in features/orders/lib/: order total, amount paid (succeeded payments only), balance, first payment due by payment policy (full / 30% deposit / pay later, see outline §5), due dates (first payment = acceptance + 24h per D8; balance and pay-later dates), the guest-facing progress label and the payment label with StatusChip tone (spec §2.1-2.3; e.g. 'Deposit paid · CHF 26.70 · CHF 62.30 left, due 24.10.2026', 'Payment processing', 'Received after cancellation · awaiting reconciliation'), commission per line (estimated vs recorded), stock available per product variant accounting for accepted-but-not-handed-over orders (AC05). (2) Pure transitions DemoState->DemoState in features/orders/lib/transitions.ts: accept (blocks when stock short, names the short line), changePickup (date or place, required note, log entry), decline (reason), startOnlinePayment / resolveOnlinePayment (succeeded, failed, processing; late result after cancellation), recordOfflinePayment (method, time, note; duplicate check = same amount within 10 demo minutes; amount above balance blocked), markReady, handOver, complete (locked with reason while balance owed; records completedBy, commission becomes Recorded once), cancel (overdue | guest | merchant; releases stock), expirePaymentDeadline (demo action). Every transition appends the log entry with actor and demo time (features/demo/clock.ts). (3) A mail log: add `mail` to DemoData (type in features/notifications/types.ts: id, at, to: 'guest'|'staff', guestId?, language, template N01..N23, orderId?, params) and bump DEMO_VERSION; transitions append the emails from outline §3 (N04/N05/N06/N07/N08/N12/N15/N21/N23). Export a `sendMail` helper so steps 1.6 (N01) and 1.7 (N02, N03) can append theirs. Leave mail rendering and the Mail panel UI to step 1.6. (4) hooks/use-orders.ts binding the transitions to useDemo().update, plus selectors hooks. (5) i18n keys for the status and payment labels under prefix `order.`.
Constraints: follow existing types in features/orders/types.ts; extend them additively only. Do not build create-orders-from-cart (step 1.7 owns it). Spec §1.3 copy rules apply to label text.
Ownership: features/orders/**, features/notifications/**, features/demo/types.ts and seed.ts (additive + DEMO_VERSION bump), i18n `order.*` keys.
Observable acceptance: a self-check script in your scratchpad, run with `npx tsx`, that loads the seed state and walks the demo path steps 9-14 (outline §1) plus the side paths (overdue, late provider result, pay later, decline, last-item race, duplicate payment, above-balance block), printing labels and balances; paste its output into your report. tsc clean for your files. Report: docs/ux/prototype/reports/T0.md.

title: 1.5 C04 Cart
body:
Target: front-end/src/routes/_guest/cart.tsx (replace the placeholder), new front-end/src/features/cart/components/* and lib/*, front-end/src/features/cart/hooks/use-cart.ts (extend).
Change: build C04 Cart per outline §1 step 4 and §2 row 1.5: lines grouped into orders by payment policy, pickup date and place (R12), each group titled Order 1, Order 2 with its policy sentence ('Full payment after confirmation', '30% deposit after confirmation', pay later) plus its date, place and subtotal; edit quantity and remove lines; states: empty cart (one sentence, one action), skeleton, a line whose date is no longer valid with the earliest valid date suggested (use features/catalog/lib/pickup.ts). Put the grouping in features/cart/lib/ as a pure function; step 1.7 will reuse it to create orders. The 'Continue' button is the hand-off to sign-in (step 1.6 builds the sheet in parallel): for now, route Continue to a no-op that step 1.7 wires, and leave a clear prop/callback for it. Cart lines come from C03 (step 1.4, built, awaiting owner review).
Constraints: native-app guest frame (430px) and patterns in decisions.tsv; never say 'delivery'; dates are requests until accepted.
Ownership: the files above and i18n keys under `cart.`.
Observable acceptance: from C03 add the knife (M, engraving Anna, Shop Altstadt, 21 Oct) and the gift box (20 Oct): C04 shows two orders with correct policy text and subtotals; empty and invalid-date states reachable; screenshots EN and DE at 375px in docs/ux/prototype/screens/1.5/. Dev server port 5181. Report: docs/ux/prototype/reports/1.5.md.

title: 1.6 C05 Sign-in sheet + Mail panel
body:
Target: new front-end/src/features/auth/ (components, hooks), front-end/src/routes/_guest/account.tsx (signed-out state only), front-end/src/features/demo/components/prototype-bar.tsx (additive: Mail panel and 'Show proposals' toggle).
Change: (1) C05 sign-in bottom sheet per outline §1 step 5 and §2 row 1.6: 'Continue with Google' (simulated) and email -> 6-digit code with InputOTP (labelled); any code works, 000000 shows wrong code, an expired-code state, resend unlocks after 30 s, 5 attempts limit (UX proposal, marked by Show proposals). Success sets data.signedInGuestId to the demo guest (Anna Keller) and calls an onSignedIn callback so the caller returns to where it was (step 1.7 uses this from the cart). Export a small API, e.g. useRequireSignIn(): (onDone) => void that opens the sheet when signed out. (2) Account tab signed-out state: a sign-in prompt that opens the sheet; signed-in shows the guest name and sign out (C14 transactions on this tab is step 1.12; leave a clear slot). (3) The prototype-bar Mail panel (outline §3): per recipient (guest, staff), in the recipient's language, list of emails with the content from spec §6. Task T0 is adding a `mail` array to DemoData and a sendMail helper in parallel: read features/notifications/ when it appears; if it is not there yet, coordinate by reading T0's files later in your task, do not create a competing store. Your sheet sends N01 with the code. (4) 'Show proposals' toggle in the prototype bar that marks UX-proposal elements (a small reusable marker component).
Constraints: prototype bar is outside the product UI. Patterns in decisions.tsv (bottom sheets).
Ownership: features/auth/**, routes/_guest/account.tsx, features/notifications/components/** (panel UI only), additive edits to prototype-bar.tsx, i18n keys `auth.`, `mail.`, `proto.`.
Observable acceptance: open the sheet from Account, sign in with Google and with email code; wrong, expired, resend timer and attempt-limit states; N01 visible in the Mail panel in EN and DE; screenshots at 375px in docs/ux/prototype/screens/1.6/. Port 5182. Report: docs/ux/prototype/reports/1.6.md.

title: 1.7 C06 Review and send request
body:
Target: new route for C06 under front-end/src/routes/_guest/ (e.g. cart.review.tsx or as the spec's /cart flow describes), new front-end/src/features/checkout/ (components, hooks, lib), cart 'Continue' wiring in features/cart (small edit), prototype-bar.tsx (additive: 'Make an item sell out').
Change: C06 per outline §1 step 6 and §2 row 1.7: per order: items, requested date and place, total, the amount due after the seller confirms, payment deadline rule, cancellation policy; combined total labelled 'for reference'; button 'Send request · no payment yet'. Wire cart Continue -> sign-in sheet (step 1.6's API) when signed out -> C06 with the cart unchanged. Build createOrdersFromCart (features/checkout/lib) using the cart grouping from step 1.5 and order snapshots (AC15: names, prices, commission rate, policies, partner from the last-click referral within 30 days, see features/partners/referral.ts), order refs SK-1042 style from nextOrderNumber, log 'requested', emails N02 (guest) and N03 (staff) via T0's sendMail; clears the cart. State: stock changed on send ('Make an item sell out' prototype-bar control) shows an error naming the item and keeps everything entered. On success go to C07 (step 1.8 builds it; navigate to a route path agreed in your report, e.g. /cart/sent).
Constraints: use T0's selectors for amounts; no stock reservation at request time (AC05).
Ownership: features/checkout/**, the C06 route, small edits to cart Continue and prototype-bar, i18n `checkout.`.
Observable acceptance: demo path steps 4-6 in EN and DE at 375px; stock-changed error; orders appear in data with correct snapshots and mail N02/N03 in the Mail panel; screenshots in docs/ux/prototype/screens/1.7/. Port 5183. Report: docs/ux/prototype/reports/1.7.md.

title: 1.9 M02 Merchant Today

Change: M02 per outline §1 step 8 and §2 row 1.9: task cards in priority order (awaiting confirmation, awaiting payment, to prepare, ready, overdue, handed over but owed), each with its count and linking to the orders list filtered (route /store/orders with a search param for the tab; step 1.10 builds that list in parallel, so agree the param name `status` with values matching spec §3.2's 7 tabs and document it in your report); three numbers: still to collect, commission to pay, completed this week; empty state 'No tasks'. Merchant layout: 375px first plus a two-column layout from 1024px (merchant-shell).
Constraints: all numbers come from T0 selectors over data.orders; role Owner and Manager both see it.
Ownership: those files, i18n `merchantToday.`.
Observable acceptance: with seed data the cards and numbers match the seeded orders (state the expected counts in your report); empty state reachable (e.g. temporarily via data); screenshots EN and DE at 375px and 1024px in docs/ux/prototype/screens/1.9/. Port 5185. Report: docs/ux/prototype/reports/1.9.md.

Then: items and engraving, guest and contact (email as copyable text), source (partner name or direct, AC11), payment history, commission (basis, rate at time of order, Estimated or Recorded), log, policy at time of order (AC15). Leave a clear slot for the fulfilment actions (Ready, Handed over, Complete, Record payment): step 1.15 adds them.

All the states in the §2 row: requested, accepted (payment due + auto-cancel warning Alert), accepted with changed place (R04 free-cancel note, UX proposal), preparing, ready, handed over with balance, completed (Write a review button slot for step 1.16), declined (with reason), cancelled (overdue, by guest; 'Request again' puts items back in the cart), payment processing (no second Pay button), payment received after cancellation.
